description:
Generates ready-to-install Google Tag Manager '<head>' and '<body>' ('<noscript>') snippets pre-populated with Google Consent Mode v2 default signals and custom dataLayer consent trigger recipes for a registered site.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'get_gtm_container_setup' after 'configure_gtm_integration' (or with an explicit 'gtm_container_id' override) when installing GTM directly. Call 'get_cookie_banner_script' or 'get_consent_banner_code' to embed the Paperloo consent UI banner script itself.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' must exist in the active registry. Uses 'gtm_container_id' override if provided, otherwise reads the container ID and GCM v2 defaults stored on the site. Read-only operation.

Returns: JSON object with 'success', 'siteId', 'gtm_container_id', 'head_snippet', 'body_snippet', 'consent_defaults', and 'consent_triggers' (or 'error' on failure).

gtm_container_id.description: Optional GTM Container ID override; defaults to the container ID already saved on the site.

siteId.description: Registered site UUID or exact registered URL.

name: get_gtm_container_setup

outputSchema.description: Google Tag Manager installation snippets and consent triggers.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

consent_defaults.description: GCM v2 default storage signals embedded in the head snippet.

consent_triggers.description: Custom dataLayer trigger definitions to configure inside GTM.

error.description: Error message if site lookup or container override fails.

gtm_container_id.description: GTM container ID embedded in the snippets.

head_snippet.description: Script snippet for <head> initializing GCM v2 defaults and loading GTM.

success.description: True if GTM setup snippets were generated; false otherwise.

title: Get Google Tag Manager Installation Snippets
